traits.name: Void Sight
traits.description: You detect anomalies and apparitions before they materialize into the physical corridor.

traits.name: Clinical Mind
traits.description: You dismiss supernatural manifestations as sensory glitches or amusing parlor tricks.
traits.perks: +2 on Wisdom saving throws against mental panic.

traits.name: Already Fractured
traits.description: A mind shattered long before entering this corridor, resilient through sheer internal fragmentation.

traits.name: Lucid Walker
traits.description: You perceive spatial distortions, trick doors, and hidden passages with piercing clarity.
traits.perks: +2 on Investigation and Puzzle deduction checks.
